name: PPJACK
recent: PPJACK 近期没有业务或财报公告，主要是董事与大股东（Lim Boon Hua、Law Book Ching、TSE Sejahtera Sdn Bhd 等）的持股变动申报，以及两名执行董事表示将在闭市期交易股票。
notable: 执行董事 Lim Boon Hua 与 Law Book Ching 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日及 19 日通过间接持股购入公司股份。
两名执行董事于 2026 年 10 月 26 日发出在闭市期交易股票意向的通知。
risks: 多名董事及大股东在 10 月密集申报持股变动，股权结构出现变化。

recent_en: PPJACK has had no business or earnings announcements recently; activity consists mainly of director and substantial shareholder interest changes (Lim Boon Hua, Law Book Ching, TSE Sejahtera Sdn Bhd and others), plus notices by two executive directors of intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: Executive Directors Lim Boon Hua and Law Book Ching acquired shares via indirect interest on 16 and 19 October 2026.
Two executive directors issued notices of intention to deal during the closed period on 26 October 2026.
risks_en: Multiple directors and substantial shareholders filed interest changes in October, indicating shifts in shareholding structure.
